responsibility: Implements the whole-function legacy reload pass that follows register allocation. It scans insns for reload needs reported by reload.cc, manages the pool of reload and spill hard registers, spills pseudos that conflict with chosen reload regs, allocates reload registers by class, emits loads/stores and autoincrement fixups, tracks reload inheritance and deadness, and iterates until all insns satisfy hard-register and addressing constraints. This is the execution engine of old reload, in contrast to reload.cc’s per-insn analysis.
